golden.label: no_fault
golden.description: Baseline golden RTL; all tests pass with zero mismatches.

fault_acc_overflow.label: accumulator_overflow
fault_acc_overflow.description: Accumulator width narrowed from 32 to 16 bits; large partial sums overflow silently.

fault_acc_w24.label: accumulator_overflow
fault_acc_w24.description: Accumulator width narrowed from 32 to 24 bits; partial sums overflow at smaller magnitude.

fault_acc_w20.label: accumulator_overflow
fault_acc_w20.description: Accumulator width narrowed from 32 to 20 bits; overflow occurs at even smaller partial sums.

fault_wrong_sign.label: sign_extension_error
fault_wrong_sign.description: Weight register cast from signed to unsigned; negative weights zero-extend instead of sign-extend.

fault_b_unsigned.label: sign_extension_error
fault_b_unsigned.description: B_reg loses signed qualifier; negative B values zero-extend instead of sign-extend.

fault_off_by_one.label: loop_boundary_error
fault_off_by_one.description: Outer-product loop terminates at N-2 instead of N-1; last column of partial sums never accumulated.

fault_loop_over.label: loop_boundary_error
fault_loop_over.description: COMPUTE spatial loop runs N+1 times (i <= N); OOB write causes row 0 to accumulate an extra partial product.

fault_subtract.label: arithmetic_error
fault_subtract.description: Accumulator subtracts partial products instead of adding; output is negated sum.

fault_reset.label: reset_polarity_error
fault_reset.description: Reset polarity inverted (active-high instead of active-low); design never resets, producing stale output.

fault_quant_reset.label: reset_polarity_error
fault_quant_reset.description: quant_unit reset polarity inverted; unit always held in reset, outputs all zeros.

fault_quant_shift_fixed.label: shift_error
fault_quant_shift_fixed.description: Per-channel shift replaced by fixed right-shift of 1; per-channel scale calibration lost.

fault_quant_no_clamp.label: saturation_error
fault_quant_no_clamp.description: INT8 saturation clamp removed; out-of-range values wrap around instead of saturating.

fault_quant_wrong_sign_zp.label: zero_point_error
fault_quant_wrong_sign_zp.description: zero_pt added as unsigned instead of signed; negative zero-points treated as large positive offsets.
